# James Clark and the Stolen Chest

## Post 10679 by Hockey8821 — 2021-05-26T15:36:00Z
<!-- url: https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=10679#p10679 | page 1 | era: pre-1.18.1 -->

Good Afternoon!

I have been leveling a warrior in Elwynn Forest and I came across a burned house with a stolen chest in it that required "James' Key" (Behind the Stonecairn Lake among the gnolls), I gave it some thought and conneted it to the James Clark that is killable at Eastvale Logging Camp, although when I managed to kill it, but it didn't drop anything.

Now here comes the suggestion:

I was thinking of some connection between James Clark and the Stolen Chest in that burned house, it would be a intresting idea since this was a quest that was scrapped in alpha or beta and was left to rot in classic wow, although since the whole server is about restoring scrapped content I thought of bringing this idea up.

Thanks for reading so far, hope it brought any insight.
Have a rest of a good day!

Alright, let's do a easy one, you start by randomly killing James Clark, after that you get a key:

[https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... JOVUxMIl0=](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)

After you get the key it will just be there, no indication on where to go and what to do. North to the Stonecairn Lake there is a burned house with a chest that is already there, and in there you can find this item:

[https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... 5VTEwiXQ==](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)

After you click on the item this is the quest you will recieve:

[https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/questcrea ... F4IjoxMH1d](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)

And after you turn it it, that's it, it's the end!
If there is any information missing feel free to quote this post and tell me about it, I'll ajust it if need be.

## Post 10690 by Hockey8821 — 2021-05-27T08:20:00Z
<!-- url: https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=10690#p10690 | page 1 | era: pre-1.18.1 -->

Alright, thanks for poiting out the points that need improving, since that is the case I think I managed to fix the quest, although I had to introduce another one in order to fix it, but here it goes:

So where the WANTED: Hogger quest is (Westbrook Garrison), on the same wooden poster there would be another post which is named WANTED: James Clark

[https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/questcrea ... I6MTB9XQ==](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)

And the reward for these quests would be something along the line of these 2 items:

[https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... JOVUxMIl0=](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)

[https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... 5VTEwiXQ==](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)

(If these Items seem way too over power feel free to change them or tell me to change, I have tried to make them as neutral as possible)

After a player accepts this quest the player would go to Eastvale Logging Camp and he would kill James Clark, and he would drop a total of three items:

[https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... JOVUxMIl0=](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)

[https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... 5VTEwiXQ==](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)

[https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... JOVUxMIl0=](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)

After this the player would pretty much have a choice, go back to Goldshire and complete the quest or investigate the treasure map (I made the treasure map a junk item and not a quest so it's the players choice to investigate). If the player decides to go towards the North of Lakecairn Lake he will find a burned house with a chest in it that requires James Key (that he already has), so he just opens the chest and in it he would find the quest item:

[https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... 5VTEwiXQ==](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)

[https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/questcrea ... I6MTB9XQ==](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)

And then he would just need to head back to Marshal Dughan in order to finish up the two quests!

I gave it a bit more thought this time and tried to keep this quest more intresting, but if there is anything else that is still missing please feel free to give me feedback
